page.overview:
Who is Carcharodontosaurus?

was a genus in the family. It was a large carnivore that lived in Northern Africa in the Late Cretaceous Period, the same time and place as Spinosaurus. Measuring 12.5 meters (41 feet) long and weighing more than six tonnes, it was among the largest predatory dinosaurs. Additionally, it gets its name from its sharp, serrated teeth which resemble the teeth seen in a great white shark, or known by its scientific name "Carcharodon carcharias".

In the game Jurassic Park: Explorer, the following information is given about this creature:

"Native to North Africa, Carcharodontosaurus had an enormous jaw with long serrated teeth that were up to 8 inches long. It's long muscular legs might have allowed it to run at speeds of up to 20 mph/ 32 kmph."

Carcharodontosaurus appeared in the website Jurassic Park Institute on Dinopedia.
